_doc: Terrace & Rose premade storylines. Beats fire for the ACTIVE household when day/hour are reached and flag requirements match. Choice effects: funds {household: cents}, rel [[a,b,delta]], set/clear flags, need [[char,need,delta]]. 'ending' marks an arc outcome. Original content.

beats.title: The Ledger on the Counter
beats.speaker: Delia Rowan
beats.text: Under the morning's flour dust, Delia finds the envelope Hazel hid: the mill wants 320.00 by Friday or the deliveries stop. Hazel says nothing and keeps kneading. Theo watches from the stairs.

choices.label: Pay the mill now
choices.result: Paid. The account balance looks thin, but the ovens stay hot.

choices.label: Ask Hazel to use her retirement savings
choices.result: Hazel writes the cheque without a word. Her coastal cottage fund just shrank.

choices.label: Pitch the Tidewell Inn a breakfast-supply deal
choices.result: Delia boxes a dozen rye rolls and heads for the inn. If the Park sisters bite, the mill bill is the least of their worries.

beats.title: Theo's Sketchbook
beats.speaker: Theo Rowan
beats.text: Theo leaves his sketchbook open on the table: the empty back room, painted floor to ceiling, an easel by the window, his name on the door. Delia had pencilled that same room as flour storage for the expansion.

choices.label: Clear the room for Theo's studio
choices.result: Theo is up past midnight painting the first wall.

choices.label: Keep it for the bakery expansion
choices.result: Theo shuts the sketchbook and doesn't come down for dinner.

choices.label: Let Hazel decide
choices.result: Hazel taps the sketchbook. "Half the room, half the dream. You'll both work for it."

beats.title: Hazel's Announcement
beats.speaker: Hazel Rowan
beats.text: Forty-one years of 4 a.m. starts. Hazel takes off her apron and folds it twice. "I want to watch the tide come in, not the dough rise. I'm retiring this season."

choices.label: Throw her a farewell bake sale
choices.result: Half the town turns up. Hazel cries into the last tray of cardamom buns. +400.00 in sales.

choices.label: Beg her to stay one more season
choices.result: She agrees. But she starts leaving brochures for coastal cottages on the counter.

choices.label: Offer a part-time 'Head of Tasting' role
choices.result: Hazel laughs for the first time in weeks. Mornings off, final say on every recipe.

beats.title: The Expansion Loan
beats.speaker: Delia Rowan
beats.text: The bank will lend 3,000.00 for a café counter and six tables, repaid from future sales. Lucia Alvarez also stopped by with an idea: flowers and bread under one roof.

choices.label: Take the bank loan
choices.result: The money lands. So does the first repayment notice.

choices.label: Partner with the Alvarez flower stall
choices.result: Rose & Rye: a florist café is born on paper. The town is already talking.

choices.label: Stay small and safe
choices.result: No new counter. No new debt. Delia isn't sure if she's relieved.

beats.title: Opening Morning: Rose & Rye
beats.text: Bread on the left, peonies on the right, a line out the door. Theo's mural greets every customer. Rose & Rye is open, and the Rowan story has a new chapter.

choices.label: Unlock the door
choices.result: Ending reached: Rose & Rye.

beats.title: Opening Morning: The Bigger Bakery
beats.text: Six new tables, a gleaming counter, and a repayment schedule taped inside the till. Delia got her expansion. Now she has to earn it.

choices.label: Start the first shift
choices.result: Ending reached: The Bigger Bakery.

beats.title: Opening Morning: Same Ovens, New Light
beats.text: Nothing changed but the light through the window. Hazel hums, Delia counts the till, and somewhere upstairs Theo is painting something nobody has seen yet.

choices.label: Bake as usual
choices.result: Ending reached: Same Ovens, New Light.

beats.title: Two Signatures
beats.speaker: June Park
beats.text: Their aunt left the Tidewell Inn to both of them: leaking roof, loyal regulars, and one sticky key. June wants to restore it. Iris has a developer's offer of 6,000.00 and a one-way ticket.

choices.label: Run it together for one season
choices.result: Iris sighs, rolls up her sleeves, and changes the sign to OPEN.

choices.label: June buys out Iris's half
choices.result: Iris takes the money and a long hug. June owns the Tidewell, every creaky board of it.

choices.label: Sell to the developer and start over
choices.result: Ending reached: the Tidewell is sold. The sisters have money, and a silence between them.

beats.title: A Baker at the Door
beats.speaker: Delia Rowan
beats.text: Delia Rowan is on the porch with warm rye rolls and a proposal: fresh breakfast for every guest, delivered at six, for a fair weekly price.

choices.label: Shake on it
choices.result: The inn's breakfasts just got famous. The Rowans' mill bill just got paid.

choices.label: Politely decline
choices.result: Delia leaves the rolls anyway. Iris eats three.

beats.title: The Roof Has Opinions
beats.speaker: Iris Park
beats.text: Overnight rain found the guest room ceiling. A roofer quotes 600.00 to fix it properly, or 100.00 for a patch that 'should hold'.

choices.label: Fix it properly
choices.result: Dry ceilings. Empty wallet.

choices.label: Patch it
choices.result: It holds. For now.

beats.title: Flowers for the Lobby
beats.speaker: Lucia Alvarez
beats.text: Lucia arrives with armfuls of sea lavender and dahlias. The lobby looks like a postcard. Iris quietly takes a photo for the website.

choices.label: Pay for the arrangements
choices.result: The first booking request arrives within the hour.

beats.title: The First Review
beats.text: A travel writer stayed last night. The review is out. June reads it aloud while Iris pretends not to listen.

choices.label: Read the review
choices.result: The review decides whether Iris stays.

beats.title: Four Ideas of Fun
beats.speaker: Renee Bell
beats.text: First family trip. Marcus wants a lakeside campsite. Renee wants museums and good coffee. Avery wants the beach. Sol, fifteen, would rather stay home with friends than 'bond'.

choices.label: Brineglass Harbor: beach and boardwalk
choices.result: Avery runs to pack a bucket and spade.

choices.label: Camping by the lake
choices.result: Marcus is thrilled. Sol asks if there's Wi-Fi. There isn't.

choices.label: City weekend with museums
choices.result: Sol shrugs, which from Sol is basically a yes.

beats.title: The Budget Talk
beats.speaker: Marcus Bell
beats.text: Laptop open, receipts out. A cabin, a nice lodge, or the splurge everyone will remember?

choices.label: Cosy cabin (300.00)
choices.result: Booked. Bunk beds included.

choices.label: Cedar lodge (800.00)
choices.result: Booked. There's a fireplace.

choices.label: Splurge (1,500.00)
choices.result: Booked. Renee quietly checks the savings balance twice.

beats.title: Sol Won't Go
beats.speaker: Sol Bell
beats.text: Sol's bag is still empty. "You two are married, not me. I didn't sign up for a new family AND a road trip."

choices.label: Insist — it's a family trip
choices.result: Sol gets in the car. Headphones in. Window down.

choices.label: Let Sol bring a friend (+100.00)
choices.result: Sol actually smiles. Twice.

choices.label: Sol stays with Hazel Rowan
choices.result: Hazel puts Sol to work kneading. Sol pretends to hate it.

beats.title: Postcards Home
beats.text: The trip is over. Sunburns, inside jokes, one argument in a petrol station. Everyone is home. (Played as a story beat until Vacations ships; booking and travel come with that milestone.)

choices.label: Look through the photos
choices.result: The photos tell you how the family really feels.

beats.title: Saturday at the Stall
beats.speaker: Noor Haddad
beats.text: Petal & Pine sold out by noon again. Noor, Lucia's oldest friend, slides a cheque across the folding table: 2,000.00 for forty percent, and she has ideas. Neon ideas.

choices.label: Accept Noor's offer
choices.result: Partners. Noor is already sketching a sign.

choices.label: Counter: 1,000.00 for twenty percent
choices.result: Noor laughs. "You learned that from me." Deal.

choices.label: Keep it just the two of you
choices.result: Noor tucks the cheque away. The friendship has a new crease in it.

beats.title: The Nursery Question
beats.speaker: Gabriel Alvarez
beats.text: Late, on the patio, among the unsold tulips. Gabriel asks the question they've both been circling: now, or when the shop is steady?

choices.label: Start trying for a baby
choices.result: They stay out until the stars come up. (Pregnancy arrives with the Family Life update.)

choices.label: Wait until the shop is steady
choices.result: A promise to revisit it at the first anniversary.

choices.label: Talk about adoption
choices.result: Lucia brings out the folder she'd been too nervous to show him.

beats.title: The Inn Order
beats.speaker: June Park
beats.text: June Park wants the Tidewell lobby full of flowers before the travel writer arrives. A big order, small deadline.

choices.label: Take the order
choices.result: Lucia is at the market at dawn.

choices.label: Too busy this week
choices.result: June understands. Mostly.

beats.title: Noor's Rebrand
beats.speaker: Noor Haddad
beats.text: Noor unveils the mock-up: hot-pink neon, 'PETAL & PINE' in letters you can see from the harbor. Gabriel's grandmother's hand-painted sign sits in the corner.

choices.label: Go neon
choices.result: It's loud. Teenagers take selfies with it. Sales tick up.

choices.label: Restore the hand-painted sign
choices.result: Gabriel repaints his grandmother's roses himself.

choices.label: Both: neon inside, heritage outside
choices.result: Everyone wins except the bank balance.

beats.title: One Year at Petal & Pine
beats.text: The stall became a shop. The shop is becoming something else. Lucia and Gabriel lock up together while Noor counts the till.

choices.label: Look back on the year
choices.result: Where Petal & Pine goes next depends on what you chose.
